page_title: BaseHalf: A canvas-first desktop workspace for thinking with files and agents

sources.entry: BaseHalf - Open-source desktop app that opens a folder as a canvas of notes, PDFs and media, with AI agents like Claude Code or Codex working on the same files beside it. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Pointa-Labs/basehalf) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: BaseHalf
summary.one_liner: BaseHalf is a free, open-source macOS desktop app that turns a folder into a canvas of notes, PDFs and media that you and terminal-based AI agents share.
use_cases: ask an AI agent about selected notes or passages
read PDFs and e-books beside notes
generate image, video or sound drafts from canvas cards
run Claude Code or Codex alongside project files
track connections between notes in plain text
summary.what_it_does: BaseHalf opens a project folder as a canvas where cards represent notes, PDFs, e-books, frames, clips and media. Drawing a line between cards writes the connection as a line of plain text in the note's upstream list, so git and agents can read it. Selecting a card or passage and asking an agent records that selection where agents like Claude Code and Codex can see it. Users can connect canvas items to an image, video or sound generator, pick a model, and generate using their own provider keys, with output saved as ordinary files in the folder. Files, Git and Search come from VS Code, and terminal agents run side by side in an Agent Area, each in its own session.
notable: Connections stored as plain text lines in files, readable by git and agents
Built-in AI image, video and sound generation using your own provider keys
Runs VS Code's Files, Git and Search underneath
No account; everything stays in an ordinary folder
caveats: Currently available for macOS on Apple Silicon only
Generation requires your own provider API keys
